# source tier

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:sourceTier`](gmeow-sourceTier.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sourceTier>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/evidence`](../../slices/evidence.md)

The bibliographic tier of the source referenced by a citation — primary, secondary, or tertiary. Non-functional: competing tier assessments coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
